name: agent-remote-monorepo
description: Native mobile remote control for coding agents (Antigravity, Codex, ACP agents) — zero web lag.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@agent-remote/protocol && npm run build --workspace=agent-remote
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@agent-remote/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=agent-remote && npm run typecheck --workspace=@agent-remote/mobile
